root_cause.text: The `check_removing_space_info` function in Btrfs frees `space_info->sub_group[]` elements directly with `kfree()` instead of calling `btrfs_sysfs_remove_space_info()`, which fails to release the associated kobjects and leaks their allocated names.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff replaces `kfree(space_info->sub_group[i])` with `btrfs_sysfs_remove_space_info(space_info->sub_group[i])` in `fs/btrfs/block-group.c`, and the CVE description explains that because `kobject_init_and_add()` is called during allocation, failing to call `btrfs_sysfs_remove_space_info()` prevents `kobject_put()` from being invoked, resulting in a leak of the `kobj->name` objects.
